system.longDesc:
Cost: 5 SP

NOTE: You may only choose stunts from this list when you earn the SP while making a Fighting (Grappling) attack.

If you have appropriate equipment in hand, like handcuffs or rope, you and your target make opposed Fighting (Grappling) rolls; if you win, they become restrained (see Conditions in Chapter 1), and can’t do anything other than try to escape with a Strength (Might) or Dexterity (Sabotage) test as a major action, with TN = 10 + (your Fighting (Grappling) score). 115
